_meta.description: Golden test set for Block 13 RAG evaluation (ADR-0005 §7).
_meta.note: AI-GENERATED MOCK SET, PENDING CO VALIDATION. These samples are synthetic and have not been reviewed by a Contracting Officer. Any RAGAS gate consuming this file MUST remain WARN-ONLY (non-blocking) until a CO-validated baseline exists — see warn_only_until. All cited regulations here have a corresponding seed source document in data/seed/far-part-42-43-32/ — samples whose substance depends on un-ingested regulations must NOT be added (a former FAR Part 49 termination-settlement sample was removed for this reason: RAGAS would score its draft against retrievable 43.x context while the real answer lives in un-ingested FAR 49, manufacturing a false-green).
_meta.warn_only_until: faithfulness_baseline.json is populated by a CO-validated RAGAS run

samples.query: Equitable adjustment for government-directed additional work. Contractor submitted certified cost or pricing data. Parties reached bilateral agreement on price and schedule impact.
samples.notes: Core bilateral type — ADR §4 Block 13 primary use case.

samples.query: Administrative change to correct unit price discrepancy in Contract Line Item 0001. No change in total contract value, scope, or schedule.
samples.notes: Administrative unilateral — signed only by CO.

samples.query: Definitize letter contract. Contractor submitted proposal with certified cost or pricing data. Parties bilaterally agreed on firm-fixed price and final contract terms.
samples.notes: Letter contract definitization — explicit FAR 43.103(a) use case.

samples.query: Add DFARS 252.232-7003 Wide Area WorkFlow clause. Contractor shall submit all payment requests and receiving reports electronically via WAWF.
samples.notes: DFARS WAWF clause insertion — unilateral administrative.

samples.query: Administrative modification to update Contracting Officer's Representative designation. Previous COR departed agency. New COR assigned per FAR 42.302 and 1.602-2(d).
samples.notes: COR update — common unilateral administrative mod.

samples.query: Bilateral modification to extend period of performance by 90 days. Extension caused by Government-furnished equipment delivery delay. No change in contract price.
samples.notes: PoP extension bilateral — parties must agree since price unchanged but time affects contractor.

samples.query: Add proper invoice requirements to contract. Invoice must include all elements required by FAR 32.905(b). Designated billing office will return improper invoices within 7 days.
samples.notes: Proper invoice clause — tests FAR 32 retrieval.

samples.query: Insert prompt payment terms. Government will pay within 30 days of receipt of proper invoice or Government acceptance, whichever is later. Interest penalties apply per 5 CFR 1315.
samples.notes: Prompt payment clause — tests FAR 32.9 and 5 CFR 1315 retrieval.

samples.query: Authority for modification: Changes clause (FAR 52.243-1). Bilateral agreement to definitize equitable adjustment for changed work directed by the contracting officer. Description of change and agreed price increase included.
samples.notes: SF-30 authority citation — tests FAR 43.301 retrieval (use of SF-30 form).

samples.query: Agency failed to return improper invoice within 7-day window required by 5 CFR 1315.4(g). Interest penalty accrual period is reduced by days beyond the 7-day return deadline. Modify contract to acknowledge interest obligation.
samples.notes: Improper invoice return failure — tests 5 CFR 1315 retrieval specifically.

samples.query: Modify contract to require WAWF three-way match: contractor invoice, COR receiving report, and contract. Electronic submission mandatory per DFARS 252.232-7003. Three-way match underpins proper invoice determination per FAR 32.905.
samples.notes: WAWF + proper invoice cross-reference — tests multi-corpus retrieval.
